authorization: The operator asked to try both choices rather than select one first. This authorizes bounded comparison of new proposed regulator/coordinate maps, not adoption of either as the canonical refinement contract or approval of a mathematical result.
question: At the first local-state-cutoff stage, what do fixed integer Q and fixed displayed amplitude sum actually preserve, and do their explicit state injections supply the requested full comparison map?

common_schedule.input_domain: j>=0 integer; fixed nonempty admitted finite anchored complex G; integers q>=1 and m>=q; R0>0. Nontrivial q is not replaced by q=0.
common_schedule.fixed_data: G, O, C, all oriented edges/closed face data, epsilon, a, beta, nu, couplings, per-root rate scales, external Markov time and stationary initial law formula. All four local-state cutoffs grow; no rate acceleration or counterterm.
common_schedule.later_order: This is only the first stage of the unchanged local-cutoff -> lattice -> volume/exhaustion -> selector -> collapse -> optional ground -> observation-time order. No later lattice/volume map is selected or limit proved.

A.name: fixed integer occupation
A.intended_preservation: Integer Q, occupation coordinates, displayed aperture and phase/link values; not an assertion about displayed radial amplitude

B.name: fixed displayed amplitude sum
B.intended_preservation: Displayed aperture, complex matter and links on the injection image, with d_j Q_j fixed. This sum is not physical mass, electric charge, energy or integrated |psi|^2.

directions.induced_observable_trace: J^*: A_fine -> A_coarse, J^*h=h composed with J
directions.requested_map_still_distinct: The earlier draft seeks p: X_fine -> X_coarse and I=p^*: A_coarse -> A_fine. An injection J does not define p on off-image fine states. No inversion, conditional expectation, rounding or quotient is implicit.

tests_before_adoption: Check the finite integer ranges, charge sector, injectivity and retained zero-radius/epsilon=1 labels for both branches
Compare sum |psi|=d_j Q_j and displayed fields under J for both branches, without interpreting it physically
Use exactly the inherited functional to check image energy equality or a discrepancy; no energy ordering between different ensembles is inferred

For every valid coarse labelled root on the issued fixture, compare a single fine root with the injected coarse endpoint and separately record the exact minimal repeated-root path. Never turn a path into a new rate
Test whether the injection image is invariant under the original fine moves; test J^* L_fine h - L_coarse J^*h on an explicit invariant full-fine observable h
Inspect integrality of an amplitude-preserving inverse of J_B on a fine tuple with odd occupations
Separate partition normalization and image conditioning from equality of displayed F; do not replace either full Gibbs state

witness_design.geometry_and_parameters: Use primary_fixture_inputs in the pinned R-570 audit, including its triangle, anchors and unmodified real parameters. No new geometry model or production inference from a table.
witness_design.seed_state: All aperture, phase and link indices zero; all coarse q at the first vertex. q,m,R0 come from the issued fixture for execution.
witness_design.fine_observable: h(x)=1 if any fine aperture index is odd, otherwise 0. This is invariant under gauge and every cell automorphism. Its trace on either doubling injection is zero.
witness_design.off_image_B: Put fine occupations 1 and 2q-1 at two distinct carried vertices and zero elsewhere. At the first fine level this is in the declared B sector and includes odd occupation labels.
witness_design.coverage: Exhaust the issued coarse fixture for state/root embedding checks, but do not enumerate a larger fine Gibbs ensemble or run a finite semigroup. General conclusions require the coordinate argument in the decision note.

evidence_plan.primary: Use the frozen v2 coordinate enumerator and exact rational displayed-field functional evaluation at the issued K=2 fixture and its K=4 image. Store exact rate coefficients and exponents for the witness.
evidence_plan.independent: A non-importing rational/SymPy implementation checks the schedule, field/radial relations, root arithmetic and witness energies/rate coefficients. Same-task authorship will be disclosed.
evidence_plan.hostile: Reject automatic inverse, zero-radius label erasure, step-count rate substitution, cross-ensemble energy ranking, and finite-pair-to-eventual or weak-limit promotion.
evidence_plan.Lean: Not required for draft comparison; no new kernel proof is claimed. If promoted later, formalize only the explicit finite coordinate facts with source assumptions.
evidence_plan.literature_role: No external theorem is a premise. The fixed-sector/variable-sector distinction is standard background, but particle-number or thermodynamic interpretations are not imported into Q. The work uses only the displayed v2 definitions and elementary integer/finite-sum identities.

verdict_boundary: This comparison can reject these particular injections as complete common-core/dynamics contracts, not all Q schedules or all comparison architectures. The old draft remains a historical uninstantiated checkpoint. No branch adoption, full p/I construction, ordered dynamics convergence or gate promotion.
non_claims: No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, Yang-Mills, mass gap, continuum or TOE
No replacement of v1/v2 states, rates, functional or time
No assertion that changing Q at different regulators makes Q nonconserved within any finite evolution
